hypothesis: CRISPR-Cas9 system can be repurposed for genome editing
prediction: Efficiency of genome editing using CRISPR-Cas9 will be higher than using zinc finger nucleases or TALENs
measurement_method: Compare the frequency of successful edits per cell using each method
falsification_condition: If CRISPR-Cas9 editing efficiency is consistently lower than or equal to that of zinc finger nucleases or TALENs in multiple cell types
